cli.description: Goslide is a blazing-fast, single-binary Markdown presentation deck builder.
cli.long:
Goslide 📽️ - A blazing-fast, single-binary Markdown presentation deck builder in Pure Go.

Instantly convert Markdown documents into self-contained interactive web slides (HTML),
16:9 borderless vector PDFs, and presenter-note-preserving PowerPoint (PPTX) presentations
with zero CGO or external runtime dependencies.

Features a built-in screencast drawing canvas (D/C keys), dual-screen presenter console (P key),
digital laser pointer (L key), and spotlight focus (S key) optimized for tutorials and talks.
cli.example:
# 1. Generate standalone interactive HTML slide (inlining images as Base64)
  goslide build presentation.md -o index.html --standalone

  # 2. Apply clean theme and specify output file path
  goslide build talk.md -t clean -o dist/talk.html

  # 3. Start live preview server with SSE hot reload and auto-open browser
  goslide serve presentation.md --port 8080 --open

  # 4. Markdown DSL Specification & AI Prompt Reference:
  #    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yundream/goslide/main/examples/example-dsl.md
cli.lang.flag: Set language for CLI and presentation UI (auto, en, ko)
cli.build.desc: Build presentation slides from Markdown source
cli.build.long:
Parses a Markdown source file (.md) and compiles it into an interactive web slide deck (HTML).

Fully supports Frontmatter metadata, 5 semantic layouts (cover, section, two-cols, blank, default),
native Chroma syntax highlighting, KaTeX math formulas, and GFM tables. Use --standalone to inline
all local image assets into a self-contained, single-file HTML bundle.
cli.build.example:
# Default build (outputs: presentation.html)
  goslide build presentation.md

  # Specify output path and bundle as standalone HTML
  goslide build presentation.md -o dist/index.html --standalone

  # Override theme (default, clean, dark)
  goslide build talk.md --theme clean

  # Apply custom external CSS stylesheet
  goslide build talk.md --theme-path ./custom.css
cli.build.flag.theme: Theme name (default, clean, dark; overrides frontmatter)
cli.build.flag.theme_path: Path to custom external CSS stylesheet
cli.build.flag.standalone: Inline local image assets as Base64 Data URIs into a self-contained bundle
cli.serve.desc: Start local development server with live reload
cli.serve.long:
Starts an ultra-fast local development server that watches the Markdown file for changes
and automatically refreshes the browser with live hot reload.

Powered by standard Server-Sent Events (SSE), updates render in under 300ms while preserving
your active slide position via URL hash sync.
cli.serve.example:
# Start default development server (http://localhost:8080)
  goslide serve presentation.md

  # Change port and automatically open default browser
  goslide serve presentation.md --port 3000 --open

  # Allow remote access (bind to 0.0.0.0)
  goslide serve talk.md --bind 0.0.0.0 -p 8080

  # Preview with dark theme and custom CSS
  goslide serve talk.md -t dark --theme-path ./custom.css
cli.serve.flag.bind: Network interface address to bind to
cli.serve.flag.open: Open presentation in default browser on start
cli.serve.flag.theme: Theme name (default, clean, dark; overrides frontmatter)
cli.serve.flag.theme_path: Path to custom external CSS stylesheet
cli.serve.flag.debounce: File watch debounce interval (filters duplicate write events)
